storyCards.headline: Dance Hall Days: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Wang Chung's "Dance Hall Days" reached #16 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #16 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

Dance Hall Days was released in 1984.

Chart story — peaked at #16 on the Hot 100.
